name: Kỹ Sư AI Thực Chiến / Practical AI Engineer
hubTitleEn: Practical AI Engineer — A Roadmap for Web Developers — js-tools
hubDescEn: A 20-lesson roadmap taking a web developer with no AI background from Python basics through linear algebra, neural networks and Transformers to LLM APIs, RAG systems and AI agents. Every lesson is hands-on, with code you run yourself.
hubHeadlineEn: Practical AI Engineer — A Roadmap for Web Developers

codeDataExemptions.data_cleaner.py: Du lieu mau la phan hoi tieng Viet cua nguoi dung — chinh no la doi tuong cua vi du, va no chung minh vi sao can encoding="utf-8". Giong nhau o ca hai locale.
codeDataExemptions.sentiment_lstm.py: Du lieu mau la danh gia dich vu tieng Viet — chinh no la doi tuong duoc phan loai, va no lam hien ro hieu ung hoc vet tu.
codeDataExemptions.aie-rnn-attention:Terminal: Dau ra in ra chinh cac cau danh gia tieng Viet dang duoc phan loai — la du lieu, khong phai comment.
codeDataExemptions.chatbot_context.py: Du lieu mau la doan hoi thoai tieng Viet giua nguoi dung va bot — chinh no la thu duoc dem token o muc 11.4, va no chung minh vi sao tieng Viet dat token hon tieng Anh.
codeDataExemptions.aie-llm-api-prompting:Terminal: Dau ra in ra chinh doan hoi thoai tieng Viet dang chay qua bo dem — la du lieu, khong phai comment.
codeDataExemptions.email_processor.py: Du lieu mau la hai email tieng Viet cua khach hang — chinh chung la thu duoc trich xuat, va phep kiem cuoi bai doi chieu dia chi trich duoc voi noi dung email do.
codeDataExemptions.aie-structured-output-tools:Terminal: Dau ra in ra chinh hai email tieng Viet dang duoc phan loai va cac tu khoa khan cap tim thay — la du lieu, khong phai comment.

codeDataExemptions.aie-chunking-vector-db:Terminal: Dau ra in ra chinh cac doan tai lieu tieng Viet dang duoc cat va xep hang — la du lieu, khong phai comment.
